Sounds like something's going
on in the plaza!{VAR BE01}
Well, let's have a little look-see.{VAR BE01}
Cheren: {VAR 0100 0000}, come here a sec.{VAR BE01}

Older Man: About that speech...
What do you think we should do?{VAR BE01}

Younger Man: Liberate Pokémon?
That's not even possible!{VAR BE01}

???: {VAR BE09 0001}Your Pokémon...{VAR BE01}
Just now, it was saying...{VAR BE09 0000}{VAR BE01}

{VAR BE09 0001}Well, {VAR 0100 0000}, is it?
Let me hear your Pokémon's voice again!{VAR BE09 0000}{VAR BE01}

Let me give you the benefit of
my experience.{VAR BE01}
You listening? The number of Pokémon
you can take with you at one time is six!

Some wild Pokémon jump out of the
tall grass and attack...{VAR BE01}
But you can make friends with those
Pokémon if you reach out to them!
